final: WITH rating_prices AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), above_average AS (SELECT *, daily_price - (SELECT AVG(daily_price) FROM rating_prices) AS excess FROM rating_prices WHERE daily_price > (SELECT AVG(daily_price) FROM rating_prices)) SELECT AVG(avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(daily_price) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_cross_rating_average FROM above_average
